ДЕЛО № 1-59/2023</div>
<br>
====================================================================================================<br>
<b>QUERY:</b> SELECT ANOTHER.LOGICALNAME, ANOTHERSTAGE.NAME, ANOTHERSTRUCT.INDEXNAME, ANOTHERSTRUCT.FIELDNAME
FROM ANOTHER,ANOTHERSTAGE,ANOTHERSTAGESTRUCT,DELO,ANOTHERSTRUCT
WHERE
(DELO.DELOID = 1540006) AND
(ANOTHER.ANOTHERID = ANOTHERSTAGE.ANOTHERID) AND
(ANOTHER.ANOTHERID not in(68,2009)) AND
(ANOTHERSTAGE.ANOTHERSTAGEID) not in (988890, 988892) AND
(ANOTHERSTAGE.ANOTHERSTAGEID = ANOTHERSTAGESTRUCT.ANOTHERSTAGEID) AND
(ANOTHERSTRUCT.FIELDNAME not like '%DUMMY%') AND
(ANOTHERSTAGESTRUCT.ANOTHERSTRUCTID = ANOTHERSTRUCT.ANOTHERSTRUCTID) AND
(ANOTHER.CARDID = DELO.CARDID) AND

FROM ANOTHER,ANOTHERSTAGE,ANOTHERSTAGESTRUCT,DELO,ANOTHERSTRUCT
WHERE
(DELO.DELOID = 1540006) AND
(ANOTHER.ANOTHERID = ANOTHERSTAGE.ANOTHERID) AND
(ANOTHER.ANOTHERID not in(68,2009)) AND
(ANOTHERSTAGE.ANOTHERSTAGEID) not in (988890, 988892) AND
(ANOTHERSTAGE.ANOTHERSTAGEID = ANOTHERSTAGESTRUCT.ANOTHERSTAGEID) AND
(ANOTHERSTRUCT.FIELDNAME not like '%DUMMY%') AND
(ANOTHERSTAGESTRUCT.ANOTHERSTRUCTID = ANOTHERSTRUCT.ANOTHERSTRUCTID) AND
